algorithm.words: count of non-overlapping matches of the regular expression \S+ over the text decoded as utf-8-sig
algorithm.bytes: raw file size on disk, including BOM and line endings
algorithm.lines: count of LF characters plus one when the decoded text is non-empty, zero when empty; the final empty segment counts (legacy benchmark convention)

context.method: historical revisions measure SKILL.md plus capitao.md; operational_words measures those files plus cli.md, which became required when the public CLI shipped

bridge.method: count despacho-*.md, execucao-*.md and pedido-*.md files; task lines are the data rows of the Markdown tables in despacho-*.md; direct_or_earlier = tasks_total minus task_lines_dispatched; transports = dispatches plus executions

proliferation.method: walk the history root; count first-level directory names by prefix; markdown = recursive .md files; the census totals remain sealed in the referenced artifacts benchmark and are not recopied here

capsules.method: line count follows algorithm.lines; max_lines is the greatest count among the matching files

unrecoverable.reason: Additional diff, code and log bytes opened by the captain were not recorded.
Explicit open and inspect actions by the captain were not recorded.
Historical reads were not logged and cannot be reconstructed from surviving files.
Messages that crossed the human bridge were not archived; only the published files survive.
Waiting and handling time on either side of the bridge was not recorded.
The historical environment did not report per-role model usage; word and byte counts are the reproducible textual proxy, not a substitute measurement.
